advisories.GHSA-q2hr-2g5m-vwhr: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-q2hr-2g5m-vwhr (moderate: quadratic-time expansion, CPU denial of service; fixed in 5.0.12). brace-expansion 5.0.9 is bundled inside aws-cdk-lib 2.271.0 (inBundle in infra/package-lock.json), so npm overrides and audit fix cannot replace it, and no aws-cdk-lib release bundles a fixed copy as of 2026-09-30 (2.271.0 is the latest). It runs only during sandboxed `make infra-synth`, through aws-cdk-lib's bundled minimatch, on asset exclude globs and construct selectors authored in this repository; no untrusted input reaches it. Nothing from infra/ is deployed or shipped: not in a StatusForge binary, the web bundle, or a Lambda function. Accepted risk recorded in docs/operations/security-review.md; re-check whenever aws-cdk-lib is bumped.
